rules.title: Unlawful to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a restraint of trade
rules.requirement: A person may not use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination in the form of a trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade or commerce in violation of the Cartwright Act chapter. A common pricing algorithm is a methodology used by two or more persons that uses competitor data to recommend, align, stabilize, set, or otherwise influence a price or commercial term. The text is general to all products and services and does not mention rental housing or rent.
rules.citation: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 16729(a) (added by AB 325, Stats. 2025, ch. 338, § 1)
rules.quoted_span: It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination in the form of a trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade or commerce in violation of this chapter.
rules.exemptions: The definition of "person" excludes the end consumer of a product or service. No other exemptions appear in this chunk.
rules.interaction: Section 16729(c) states that nothing in the section impairs or limits the applicability of antitrust laws.

rules.title: Unlawful to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm while coercing adoption of its recommended price or term
rules.requirement: A person may not use or distribute a common pricing algorithm if the person coerces another person to set or adopt a recommended price or commercial term recommended by the algorithm for the same or similar products or services in California. The text is general to all products and services and does not mention rental housing or rent.
rules.citation: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 16729(b) (added by AB 325, Stats. 2025, ch. 338, § 1)
rules.quoted_span: It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm if the person coerces another person to set or adopt a recommended price or commercial term recommended by the common pricing algorithm for the same or similar products or services in the jurisdiction of this state.
rules.exemptions: The definition of "person" excludes the end consumer of a product or service. No other exemptions appear in this chunk.
rules.interaction: Section 16729(c) states that nothing in the section impairs or limits the applicability of antitrust laws.
